description: This file is a CMake module script used to locate and configure the OpenBLAS library for the build process. It sets search paths, finds the include directory and library file for OpenBLAS, checks their presence, and reports the status. It also performs a runtime check on the OpenBLAS library to see if it is directly linked against libgomp.

methods.name: FIND_PATH
methods.description: Finds the directory path containing the specified header files for OpenBLAS.

methods.name: FIND_LIBRARY
methods.description: Finds the library file for OpenBLAS.

methods.name: execute_process
methods.description: Runs an external command (ldd) on the OpenBLAS library to analyze its linked dependencies.
